beats.text: Trump signed an order creating a commission for military spouses. Then, mid-signing, he decided it was really about him.

beats.caption: I have one question: how do I compare in terms of response with other presidents of the past?
beats.label: via The White House

beats.text: Bold question to ask the one person in the room standing behind you with no exit.
Diplomatic. Almost too diplomatic -- so naturally, he asked again.

beats.caption: Is it good or bad? -- No, it's good. Actually, it's very good.
beats.label: via The White House

beats.text: Still not specific enough. He had one particular predecessor in mind.

beats.caption: A little more than sleepy Joe? -- 100%.
beats.label: via The White House

beats.text: According to Yahoo News and The Blast, observers called it a total creep question -- put to a military spouse, at an event meant to honor her, not grade him.
